elements.name: q4
elements.title: A link is distinguishable from surrounding text only by color. What is a useful improvement?
choices: Add another visible cue such as underlining

elements.name: q5
elements.title: A tooltip appears on keyboard focus. What should a user be able to do?
choices: Move the pointer onto it when applicable and dismiss it without moving focus, subject to the criterion

Check only the logo at full width

answer_key.q4: Add another visible cue such as underlining
answer_key.q5: Move the pointer onto it when applicable and dismiss it without moving focus, subject to the criterion
answer_key.q6: Test applicable content at a narrow equivalent viewport without loss of information or functionality

explanations.q1: The accessible name should communicate the action.
explanations.q2: Audio description communicates relevant visual information.
explanations.q3: The group and legend expose the shared relationship.
explanations.q4: Information should not depend solely on color.
explanations.q5: The hover or focus content criterion has dismissible, hoverable, and persistent conditions and exceptions.
explanations.q6: Reflow testing examines whether content and functionality remain usable at the applicable dimensions.
